title: TCH — burnToken Signature Malleability Analysis
root_cause: The `burnToken(uint256 amount, uint256 nonce, bytes memory signature)` function accepts manipulated signatures as valid even when the last byte (`v` value) is altered from `0x1c`→`0x01` or `0x1b`→`0x00` — a signature malleability vulnerability. Called 34 times to mass-burn TCH → price distortion followed by profit-taking
steps: → [3] Tamper the v byte of a legitimate signature (0x1c → 0x01, etc.)
TCH burned on every call → supply collapses
